problem: The native chat composer accepted text only and had no safe way to drop, preview, remove, or send images and files with a task.
solution: Added a centralized attachment policy, a file and image importer, native NSTextView file-drop interception, SwiftUI drop targeting, a multi-file picker, thumbnail and file cards, duplicate and size limits, attachment-only sending, task-bound cleanup, late-callback invalidation, and an explicit untrusted local-path manifest for agent tools.
lesson: Reliable macOS attachment UX needs two coordinated drop paths: a SwiftUI drop destination for hover feedback and non-file image providers, plus an NSTextView destination for file URLs dropped directly over the editor. Stable local paths and an explicit trust boundary let tool-capable agents inspect files without inflating requests or treating file content as instructions.
